description: This file defines a Java class 'TrieBasedPolicyAlgorithmBenchmark' which extends 'AbstractPoliciesBenchmark' and overrides the 'getPolicyAlgorithm' method to instantiate a 'TrieBasedPolicyAlgorithm' with a given policy. It serves as a benchmark for testing Trie-based policy algorithms in a testing environment.

classes.name: TrieBasedPolicyAlgorithmBenchmark
classes.description: A benchmark class extending 'AbstractPoliciesBenchmark', designed to test policy algorithms using a trie-based approach.

methods.name: getPolicyAlgorithm
methods.description: Overrides the method to return a new instance of 'TrieBasedPolicyAlgorithm' initialized with the provided 'Policy' object.
